parameters.jsCode:
const paths = $input.item.json.stdout.trim().split(',').filter(p => p.length > 0);
return paths.map(path => ({ json: { path: path.trim() } }));

const allIds = $input.all().map(i => i.json.run_id).join(',');
return [{ json: { run_ids_str: allIds } }];

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  '{{ $json.run_id }}' AS run_id,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM measurement_run mr
    JOIN runs r ON r.uniqueref = mr.run_ref
    WHERE r.run_id = '{{ $json.run_id }}'
  ) AS has_measurements
FROM runs
WHERE run_id = '{{ $json.run_id }}'
  AND status_concept_ref = 29
